subject: Security onramp milestones & MAP—timeline, owners, and evidence ask

From: Ana López <ana.lopez@praxisbank.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@praxisbank.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Security onramp milestones & MAP: next steps

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, PraxisBank needs a concise MAP that calls out the security/compliance gates we require to complete evaluation and proceed to signature. Topline constraints from procurement and risk:

- SOC 2 Type II evidence (current report + control owner contacts)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ questionnaire for hosting and data access controls
- DPA with EU data residency and breach notification SLA language clarified
- Explicit data retention matrix for logs, transaction data, and ML training pipelines

Our target close window is high priority: we need full security acceptance (risk signoff) within 3 weeks to make the November procurement cycle. Can you provide a MAP with milestones, owners, and deliverables by EOD today so we can align internally?

Also, please include the channel/owner for the SIG review—our InfoSec team prefers a single point of contact to avoid repeated back-and-forth.

Appreciate it,

Ana López
Head of Third‑Party Risk
PraxisBank
security@praxisbank.com

Attachment: reference: praxis-risk-template.pdf (see internal bank template for preferred fields)

Hi Ana — thanks, very helpful context. Draft MAP attached (MAP_v1.xlsx) with a focused security lane at the top. Highlights below and asks inline:

SUMMARY (high-level)
- Goal: Security acceptance and contract signature within 3 weeks to hit Nov procurement runway
- Owners: Redwood (Avery — SIG coordination; Kim — DPA & retention; Connor — SOC 2 evidence intake)
- Key deliverables: SOC 2 Type II package, completed SIG/CAIQ, DPA redline, data retention matrix, short incident response summary

TIMELINE (compressed 3-week runway — target: 2028-10-03 contract sign)
- Day 0 (today): Deliver MAP_v1.xlsx + evidence intake checklist (attached SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf)
- Day 2: Praxis receives SOC 2 package; Redwood provides control-owner contacts and recent penetration test summary
- Day 5–8: SIG/CAIQ Q&A cycle (single point: avery_johnson@redwood.com)
- Day 10: DPA redline exchange — propose fast-track clause for EU residency and 72-hour notification SLA
- Day 14–21: Final risk closure & sign-off

ASKS / OPEN QUESTIONS
- Can Praxis accept a 3‑year retention baseline with transaction logs aggregated to pseudonymous IDs for training? If not, please mark the row in the attached MAP_v1.
- Are there any mandatory auditor or escrow requirements we should preemptively include?

ATTACHMENTS (stubs): MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-ask.pdf

I'll own the SIG coordination (single point). Kim will lead DPA negotiation and will propose the EU residency language. Connor will intake SOC2 materials and share the control lead contacts.

If that matches Praxis expectations we'll lock the timeline and start the intake.

Best,

Avery — quick clarifying note for the MAP before we send final:

- DPA scope: Ana mentioned EU residency. We should propose a carveout table: (i) customer data (dedicated tenant) stored in EU region; (ii) logs/telemetry retention — default 24 months but configurable; (iii) backups — 90 days encrypted, unless customer requests longer. Praxis is a bank; they may require longer for audit.
- Retention for ML training: we need explicit opt-in from customers for using transaction-derived features in models. We should include an operational control and a CIAM contact.
- SOC 2 package: Connor, can you confirm we can provide control owner emails and last Type II report redacted for customer PII? Also include pen test summary and remediation closure dates.

I'll draft proposed DPA bullets and attach DPA_redline_v2.docx to the next message.

—Kim

Avery/Kim,

Thanks — this is close. A couple of binding constraints from Risk & Legal: 

1) Retention: Praxis requires transaction-level retention of up to 7 years for core ledger records; analytics-derived artifacts can be restricted to 2 years for ML unless explicitly approved by compliance. Please reflect ledger retention as a non-negotiable row in the MAP.
2) DPA: We need the DPA to include an explicit clause requiring EU-only processing for customer data related to EU customers, plus an audit clause allowing an external auditor to validate controls once per year.
3) SIG/CAIQ: we'll send the filled questionnaire — prefer a single spreadsheet to avoid divergence. I'll attach our SIG template.

Procurement also asked to see an abbreviated incident response summary (what we provide within 72 hours, severity taxonomy, and post-incident remediation window). If you can include that we can accelerate approval.

Attached: SIG-CAIQ_fillable.xlsx (we'll complete and return within 48 hours).

Regards,

Ana López
Head of Third‑Party Risk
PraxisBank
